description: Build the React + TypeScript (.tsx) web page that drives the engine from FEAT-001: a prompt input to kick off the pipeline, live per-agent status/output cards for the five roles, a task board, and a streaming activity log. Wire the no-bundler runtime (index.html import map + Bun dev server + build) and write the Portuguese README. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Create index.html at repo root: an ESM import map mapping "react", "react-dom", "react-dom/client", "react/jsx-runtime", "react/jsx-dev-runtime" to esm.sh CDN URLs (pinned React 18 versions), a root <div id="root">, and <script type="module" src="/dist/main.js"></script>. Include a <noscript> and basic meta/lang="pt-BR". The import map means the BROWSER loads React at runtime; nothing is npm-installed.

Create dev-server.ts: a Bun server (Bun.serve) that serves index.html and static assets, and transpiles .tsx/.ts on the fly OR simply serves the pre-built dist/main.js and rebuilds on request. Simplest robust path: serve dist/main.js (built via `bun run build`) and static files; print the localhost URL. Must run offline with `NODE_OPTIONS= bun run dev-server.ts`.
Create src/main.tsx: import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client', mount <App/> into #root.

Create src/ui/App.tsx: top-level component holding PipelineState via useState; a prompt <textarea> + 'Iniciar' button that constructs a MockLLMProvider + Orchestrator and calls run(prompt, onEvent) updating state on each emitted snapshot (use a small default delay so progress animates). Show overall phase/progress and a reset/'Novo projeto' control. All UI copy in Portuguese.

Create src/components/AgentCard.tsx: renders one agent with name, its role badges (supports multiple roles), status (idle/working/done/error with color), current task, and latest output; props-typed against engine types.
Create src/components/TaskBoard.tsx: renders the task list grouped/ordered by role with status indicators.
Create src/components/ActivityLog.tsx: renders the streaming LogEntry list (newest first or auto-scroll), showing agent/role, message, timestamp, level.
Create src/components/PromptPanel.tsx: the prompt entry + start button (extracted for clarity), with a few example prompts for web projects.

Create styles: a single src/styles.css (linked from index.html) OR inline style objects. Prefer a styles.css with a clean dashboard layout (header, prompt panel, agent grid, task board, log). Keep it dependency-free (no CSS framework install).
Ensure all .tsx typecheck under the react-shim: extend src/types/react-shim.d.ts as needed for any hooks/events/props used so `tsc --noEmit` stays green. Run prettier and eslint.

Create README.md in Portuguese (pt-BR): describe o projeto 'Ecossistema', o conceito dos agentes de IA (IA CEO, Arquiteto, Front-end, Back-end, Integrador) e que uma IA pode ter mais de uma funcao; como rodar (NODE_OPTIONS= bun run build; NODE_OPTIONS= bun run dev; abrir a URL), explicar a restricao offline (sem acesso a APIs reais de LLM no sandbox, por isso o MockLLMProvider), e documentar claramente o ponto de extensao LLMProvider para plugar um backend real (OpenAI/Anthropic) depois. Explicar o requisito de internet do navegador para o import map (React via CDN).
Verify end to end: NODE_OPTIONS= tsc --noEmit passes; NODE_OPTIONS= bun run build emits dist/main.js; NODE_OPTIONS= bun test still passes.
acceptance_criteria: `NODE_OPTIONS= bun run build` succeeds and produces dist/main.js
index.html contains an import map resolving react and react-dom to a CDN and loads dist/main.js as a module

The App renders a prompt input, five agent roles are represented (ceo, architect, frontend, backend, integrator) as cards, and starting the pipeline updates agent statuses and the activity log from the orchestrator events
README.md exists, is written in Portuguese, documents the offline/mock constraint and the LLMProvider extension point
`NODE_OPTIONS= bun test` still passes (no regressions to the engine)
findings: Built the full React UI on top of the FEAT-001 engine. Files created: index.html (ESM import map -> esm.sh React 18.3.1 for react/react-dom/jsx-runtime/jsx-dev-runtime, <div id=root>, lang=pt-BR, <noscript>, links /src/styles.css and /dist/main.js), dev-server.ts (Bun.serve static server, path-traversal guard, SPA fallback to index.html, prints localhost URL, serves html/js/css with correct content-types), src/main.tsx (createRoot(<App/>)), src/ui/App.tsx (holds PipelineState, phase label + progress bar, 'Novo projeto' reset, constructs new Orchestrator(new MockLLMProvider(), { stepDelayMs: 500 }) and updates state on each onEvent snapshot, with error handling), src/components/{PromptPanel,AgentCard,TaskBoard,ActivityLog}.tsx, src/styles.css (dependency-free dashboard, CSS grid, status/role color system). README.md in pt-BR (conceito, tabela de papeis, multi-funcao via 'Ada' ceo+integrator, como rodar com NODE_OPTIONS=, restricao offline + MockLLMProvider, ponto de extensao LLMProvider com exemplo OpenAILLMProvider, nota sobre internet do navegador para o import map). All UI copy is Portuguese; all five roles rendered as agent cards. DEVIATIONS: (1) Changed package.json build script from `--external "*"` to `--external react --external react-dom --external react/* --external react-dom/*`. The planned `--external "*"` externalizes relative imports too (./ui/App), so it emitted a broken 376-byte bundle that only re-imported ./ui/App (which does not exist at runtime). The corrected globs bundle all 10 local modules (~24KB) while keeping ONLY the bare react specifiers external for the browser import map. (2) Extended src/types/react-shim.d.ts: set JSX.Element.key to `string | number | null` (was `unknown`) so component bodies returning JSX are assignable to FC (ReactElement | null); added JSX.IntrinsicAttributes { key? } so `key` is accepted on components/elements without being declared in each props type. VERIFICATION (all pass): `NODE_OPTIONS= tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` exits 0; `NODE_OPTIONS= bun run build` emits dist/main.js (24.61 KB, react imports external); `NODE_OPTIONS= bun test` => 10 pass / 0 fail (no engine regressions); prettier --check and eslint clean; dev-server smoke test returns 200 for /, /dist/main.js, /src/styles.css with correct content-types. NOTE: dist/ is gitignored (not committed), rebuilt via the build script. Prettier reformatted App.tsx and styles.css during the run (committed in formatted form).
